messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning to deploy meridian-2b to the model catalog tomorrow 09:30 PDT. Who can own smoke checks?
jinwoo: I can do smoke checks. Will be available 09:15-10:30. Any special tests we should run?
maria: thx @jinwoo. Tests: quick generate prompt, embeddings sanity, perf pin to default quant profile. Checklist below.
maria: ```preflight checklist
- push model artifact to registry (done)
- update catalog.yaml with version/sha
- stage in staging and run smoke harness (3 prompts)
- validate embeddings across shard 0/1
- run perf probe for 95p latency and token cost
- prepare rollback command
```
sam: FYI I've updated the catalog PR: https://git.redwood/repo/meridian/pr/412 — includes fallback mapping to meridian-2b-lite.
claire: I'll watch metrics and have rollback ready. What rollback command do we use again?
maria: rollback is `infractl catalog rollback --model meridian-2b --to sha=<sha>` (we'll post exact sha in thread before deploy).
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy window accepted for 2026-04-02 16:30 UTC by @maria
jinwoo: note: meridian-2b has slightly longer KV cache warmup. For smoke, run a 50-token history prompt to prime KV.
maria: good call. Also do a short generator and a few embeddings for index shards 0 and 1.
ops-bot: smoke harness run template: `scripts/smoke_run.sh meridian-2b --prompts smoke_prompts.json --embeddings 2`
sam: quick lgtm from me on the PR. @maria add the sha and I'll merge just before the deploy.
claire: I created a dashboard: /dashboards/model/meridian-2b-smoke — I'll post snapshots during checks.
maria: outstanding: confirm security review (SLA), and ensure dedicated capacity pool doesn't conflict. @eng-sre FYI
alex: confirmed no dedicated pool conflicts; SRE on-call will be @alex during window.
maria: ok. Plan: 16:20 UTC merge + artifact push, 16:30 UTC trigger deploy, 16:35-16:45 smoke, 16:50 finalize pin to stable if ok.
jinwoo: I'll post smoke results here with timings and error counts. If 95p latency > 600ms or errors > 0.5% we rollback.
sam: I'll keep PR ready. If rollback, I'll revert PR immediately and tag @eng-ops to run `infractl catalog rollback`.
claire: ack. will capture traces and a couple of LLM outputs for quality check.
maria: perfect. small note: pin policy will route 20% to previously stable for 1 hour as additional safety.
jinwoo: thanks, see you all tomorrow. :party_parrot: 
deploy-bot: reminder scheduled: meridian-2b deploy in 22 hours.
maria: adding final sha: sha=abc123def456 — use this for rollback command above.
